review_notes: [case_series] Reports specific MECP2 gene variants in 9 Rett syndrome patients (e.g., c.913insT, c.316C>T, c.502C>T, c.808C>T, c.1126C>T with amino acid changes such as R106W, R168X, R270X, P376S; HGVS-style nomenclature included). Study design is a small clinical case series analyzing mutations in affected children and their parents.
